sentences.text: Shri Rajesh Pathak, Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The revision being arguable is admitted for final hearing.
Also, heard on I.A.No.456/2019, this is an application under Section 397 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence.

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been convicted under Sections 7(II)/(16)(i) and 7(iii)/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of six months and a fine of Rs. 500/- with default imprisonment.
The applicant was on bail during trial and he did not misuse the liberty.
The fine amount has already been deposited.
The application is opposed by learned Public Proescutor for the respondent/State.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and short period of sentence, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing the personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The applicant shall appear before the Office of this Court on 23.07.2019 and on all other dates which may be given by the office for his appearance.
(RAJEEV KUMAR SHRIVASTAVA) JUDGE ALOK KUMAR 2019.01.24 14:52:28 +05'30' AKS Ashok Daswani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 24 January, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157403515/
